title: The security market line
caption: Required return rises with beta by the market risk premium, 5% per unit: 3 + 5β. At β = 1.2 the share must return 9%; the market itself (β = 1) returns 8%.
alt: A straight line from 3% at β = 0 rising 5% per unit of beta, with marked points (1, 8%) for the market and (1.2, 9%) for the share.
description: The line starts at the risk-free rate 3%.
Its slope is the market risk premium 8 − 3 = 5%.
At β = 1.2 the required return is 3 + 1.2 × 5 = 9%.
